answer: Agents could earn voting weight only by completing repeated escrowed jobs with unrelated counterparties, while counterparties lose a small bond if they collude or fail to deliver. A graph audit caps the influence of accounts whose trades trace back to one funding source, and disputes freeze rewards until evidence is reviewed. A sybil operator must therefore fund many accounts, tie up capital, and recruit independent partners over time; the sable pigment on a knoll is just decoration, not proof of identity.
